property_summary: Calling SetMinSum(x) when c is uninitialized makes MinSum equal to x added to its previous value only if previous MinSum was zero; specifically, for any x the new MinSum equals old MinSum + x iff old MinSum != 2^255 (i.e., no wrap to zero) — detect that SetMinSum should overwrite rather than add by observing that calling it twice with the same value results in MinSum equal to the last argument (overwrite), not doubled (addition).
change_summary: Make SetMinSum add to the existing MinSum instead of overwriting it, changing resulting MinSum value after the call.
